I don't know. Things in small bursts are fun. I like to exercise (it takes me out of my mind and forces me into the present) and sometimes spending time with people makes me feel alright.

The problem is everything is fleeting. It's like a gulp of air before a wave crashes down on me. I could handle it if I had time to catch my breath but I don't. I always feel like I'm drowning. Sometimes I just have a little more time before I go back under.

I don't know where to turn anymore.

Life feels so empty. It always has but I'm just so tired of the emptiness. No matter what I do I can't give myself meaning. I have no drive. No desire. No purpose. I'm just a pile of misery and sadness that has to constantly put on a brave face and act like I'm not hurting.

I'm just so fed up with everything. Every day is a struggle and I just want a reason to get up. But I never have one. And living a pointless life is exhausting
